tool_input_args.name: command
tool_input_args.value:
python3 << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image
import pytesseract
from openpyxl import Workbook

# OCR the image
img = Image.open("/workspace/testbed/images/invoice.png")
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img).strip()
print("=== Extracted Text ===")
print(text)
print("======================")

# Write to Excel — one line per row in column A
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice Data"
for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=line)

wb.save("/workspace/invoice_data.xlsx")
print("Saved invoice_data.xlsx")
EOF
